rows.grounds: compound locative form with fused sandhi

items.question: Where is nyāsa placed at the index-thumb junction, and how does it apply to all?
items.inference: The index-thumb junction is the nyāsa point for all.
uncertainties: exact sandhi resolution of sarvāsvaṅguṣṭhato remains uncertain
items.plain_english: Nyāsa is placed at the junction of index finger and thumb; for all, it proceeds from the thumb.
